ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 65% of the visible surface area against low-intensity black borders and central region, creating a stark contrast ratio of roughly 1.8:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the centers of both lobes. The left lobe contains a distinctive dark 'X' shaped cluster of low-intensity pixels. The right lobe contains a series of 5-7 small, circular dark-ringed spots scattered across the high-intensity field. Low-intensity black pixels define the perimeter and the central area surrounding the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a pixel-based aperture angle of approximately 75 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the superior boundary of both lobes, characterized by high-frequency peaks (0.5-2.0 pixels in amplitude relative to local mean) and valleys, particularly pronounced on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer distal edges follow a convex mathematical curve that sweeps upward and outward, terminating in pointed tips heavily laden with three-dimensional surface clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple annular (ring-like) low-intensity pixel clusters are detected on the white field of the right lobe. A singular, highly defined circular dark ring is visible near the bottom edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned light-intensity linear marks are visible traversing the dark central pigment area and the upper-right lobe trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, three-dimensional clusters of high-intensity white/grey pixel formations (barnacles) are present on both the left and right fluke tips. A distinct 'X' shaped dark scar is visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'X' shaped pigmentation mark on the left lobe and the constellation of circular rosettes on the right lobe represent unique identification markers.
